name: io.github.tonyyang0504/ecwid-mcp
description: Ecwid by Lightspeed (ecommerce channels): me, create_listing, update_listing, end_listing, set_inven

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ECWID_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Secret token of a custom app (Ecwid admin > Apps > Develop Apps > app Details; scopes read_catalog, create_catalog, update_catalog, read_orders, update_orders); non-expiring, sent as `Authorization: Bearer secret_...`.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ECWID_STORE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Ecwid store id (shown in the admin footer / URL); every call goes to https://app.ecwid.com/api/v3/{store_id}/...
